e.body:
**ActuaryRadar** 是一个开源的精算行业情报聚合与学习平台（仓库 `wjr0704/actuaryradar`），**MIT 许可，实测 ★3、fork 0、主语言 JavaScript、仓库体量 2,103 KB、创建于 2026-07-06、最后推送 2026-09-10**（**全部为 GitHub API 实测值**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「可核实性的四种做法」**中的**第一种：靠精选来源（curation）****。

可核实信息（**均由 GitHub API 与 README 逐字实测**）：**README 实测 3,310 字节**，首句逐字为 **「ActuaryRadar」**，副标题逐字为 **「An AI-powered all-in-one Insurance Intelligence & Actuarial Learning Platform.」**；**其功能清单逐字实测为七项**：**Curated Insurance Intelligence（精选保险情报）**、**Personalized Learning Journey（个性化学习路径）**、**Actuarial Knowledge Library（精算知识库）**、**Company Results（公司业绩）**、**Regulatory Updates（监管更新）**、⭐ **Trusted Public Sources（可信公共来源）**、**AI-assisted Learning（AI 辅助学习）**；**技术栈自述逐字实测为 Next.js / React / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS / Netlify / AI-assisted development**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「Trusted Public Sources」被单列为一项功能，是本轮最值得注意的一点**——**一个工具把「来源是否可信」做成产品里的一等公民，而不是让用户自己去判断**；**这与本词条所在站点的做法同源：不是给你更多链接，而是标注来源**（**可与池内 [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]] 的术语来源、[[actuarial-open-book]] 的开源教材体系并读——三者都是「把可信材料的入口集中起来」，但一个做术语、一个做教材、一个做行业动态**）。**② ⭐ 「公司业绩 + 监管更新 + 再保险洞察」三项合起来，说明它覆盖的是**行业跟踪**而非仅学习**——**可与池内 [[triple-i]]（美国行业数据与洞察）、[[asia-insurance-review]] 与 [[reinsurance-news]]（行业新闻）并读**：**那些是内容生产者，而 ActuaryRadar 是内容**聚合者****；**对精算学生，「每天要看的几个来源」被收进一个页面是有实际价值的**（**本次未打开站点，故不转述其实际收录了哪些来源、更新频率或覆盖面**）。**③ ⚠️ 最重要的一条如实标注：README 自己写明当前形态与所述技术栈不一致**——**其原文逐字为「the current MVP is a static Python/JavaScript prototype that generates a deployable site. The stack above reflects the intended production directi[on]」**——**即**上面那份 Next.js/React 技术栈是「预期方向」而非现状，现阶段的 MVP 只是一个生成静态站点的 Python/JavaScript 原型****；**同时其截图表格中三处实测均为「Placeholder」，README 亦写明「Screenshots will be added soon」**——**故本词条明确不主张该平台已具备所述的现代前端形态，也不主张其已有可用界面**。**这一条正是本轮主题的反面教材：**当一个项目把「可信来源」当卖点时，读者更应先看清它自己现在到底跑起来了多少****。**④ ⭐ 「AI-assisted development」被列入技术栈，说明该项目自身也是 AI 辅助开发的产物**（**与池内 [[agentic-bop-underwriting]]、[[claude-code]] 所代表的开发方式同属一类现象；本次未核实其 AI 辅助的具体程度**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据（★数、fork、许可、语言、体量、创建与推送时间）与 README 全文（3,310 字节）**，**未克隆仓库、未运行、未打开其线上站点、未核实其是否已部署**，因此**不能转述其实际功能、数据来源清单、覆盖面或更新频率**；**② ⭐ 技术栈为**README 自述且被 README 自身标注为「预期方向」****——**词条内已如实说明现阶段的 MVP 形态，不主张其已实现该技术栈**；**③ 截图实测为占位符（Placeholder），故不主张该项目已有可展示界面**；**④ ★3 说明关注度很低**，**本词条不主张其成熟度、用户规模或被行业采用**；**⑤ 「AI 驱动」为**项目自述**，**其 AI 成分的具体实现与效果本次未核实**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**；**⑦** 本词条**不主张**该项目提供精算计算、定价模型或可下载数据集**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/wjr0704/actuaryradar` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（元数据字段与 README 原文均已逐字核对）；**未运行、未部署核实、未打开线上站点**。
e.body_en:
**ActuaryRadar** is an open-source insurance-intelligence aggregation and actuarial learning platform (repository `wjr0704/actuaryradar`), **MIT licensed, with measured ★3, 0 forks, JavaScript as the primary language, a 2,103 KB repository, created 2026-07-06 and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all measured via the GitHub API**). It belongs to the first of this round’s four approaches to verifiability: **relying on curated sources (curation)**.

Verifiable details (**all measured verbatim from the GitHub API and README**): the **README measures 3,310 bytes**, its subtitle stating verbatim **"An AI-powered all-in-one Insurance Intelligence & Actuarial Learning Platform."**; **its feature list measurably names seven items**: **Curated Insurance Intelligence**, **Personalized Learning Journey**, **Actuarial Knowledge Library**, **Company Results**, **Regulatory Updates**, ⭐ **Trusted Public Sources** and **AI-assisted Learning**; and **the self-described stack measurably reads Next.js / React / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS / Netlify / AI-assisted development**.

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ That "Trusted Public Sources" is listed as a feature in its own right is the round’s most notable point** — **the tool makes source trustworthiness a first-class part of the product rather than leaving users to judge it alone**; **the same instinct as the site this entry lives on: not more links, but labelled sources** (**readable with [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]’s terminology sources and [[actuarial-open-book]]’s open textbook system — all three centralise entry points to trustworthy material, one for terms, one for textbooks, one for industry developments**). **② ⭐ Company results, regulatory updates and reinsurance insights together show it covers industry tracking rather than learning alone** — **readable with [[triple-i]] (US industry data and insight), [[asia-insurance-review]] and [[reinsurance-news]]**: **those produce content, whereas ActuaryRadar aggregates it**; **for an actuarial student, the daily reading list collected onto one page has real value** (**the site was not opened, so what it actually indexes, how often it updates, and its coverage are not restated**). **③ ⚠️ The most important honest note: the README itself states that the current form does not match the described stack** — **its verbatim wording is "the current MVP is a static Python/JavaScript prototype that generates a deployable site. The stack above reflects the intended production directi[on]"** — **i.e. that Next.js/React stack is a stated direction, not the present reality, and today’s MVP is merely a Python/JavaScript prototype that generates a static site**; **moreover three cells of its screenshot table measurably read "Placeholder" and the README states "Screenshots will be added soon"** — **so this entry explicitly does not claim the platform has the modern front end described, nor that it has a usable interface**. **This is the round’s counter-example: when a project’s selling point is trusted sources, the reader should first see how much of it actually runs today**. **④ ⭐ "AI-assisted development" appearing in the stack shows the project is itself an AI-assisted build** (**the same phenomenon as [[agentic-bop-underwriting]] and [[claude-code]]; the degree of AI assistance was not verified**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the repository metadata (stars, forks, licence, language, size, creation and push dates) and the full 3,310-byte README**, **but did not clone, run, or open any deployed site**, so **its actual functionality, source list, coverage and update frequency cannot be restated**; **② ⭐ The stack is a README self-description that the README itself labels as a direction** — **the entry states the current MVP form honestly and does not claim that stack is implemented**; **③ Screenshots measurably read as placeholders, so no presentable interface is claimed**; **④ ★3 indicates very low attention**, **and the entry claims no maturity, user base or industry adoption**; **⑤ "AI-powered" is the project’s own description**, **and the concrete AI implementation and its effectiveness were not verified**; **⑥ whether Chinese-language material exists was not verified**; **⑦** this entry **does not claim the project provides actuarial computation, pricing models or a downloadable dataset**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/wjr0704/actuaryradar` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (metadata fields and README text checked verbatim); **nothing was run, no deployment was verified and no live site was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**ActuaryRadar** 是一個開源的精算行業情報聚合與學習平台（倉庫 `wjr0704/actuaryradar`），**MIT 許可，實測 ★3、fork 0、主語言 JavaScript、倉庫體量 2,103 KB、創建於 2026-07-06、最後推送 2026-09-10**。本條目屬本輪主題**「可核實性的四種做法」**中的**第一種：靠精選來源（curation）****。

可核實資訊（**均由 GitHub API 與 README 逐字實測**）：**README 實測 3,310 位元組**，副標題逐字為 **「An AI-powered all-in-one Insurance Intelligence & Actuarial Learning Platform.」**；**其功能清單逐字實測為七項**：**Curated Insurance Intelligence／Personalized Learning Journey／Actuarial Knowledge Library／Company Results／Regulatory Updates／⭐Trusted Public Sources／AI-assisted Learning**；**技術棧自述逐字實測為 Next.js / React / TypeScript / Tailwind CSS / Netlify / AI-assisted development**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 「Trusted Public Sources」被單列為一項功能，是本輪最值得注意的一點**——**一個工具把「來源是否可信」做成產品裡的一等公民**（可與 [[actuarial-glossary-multilingual]]、[[actuarial-open-book]] 並讀——**三者都是「把可信材料的入口集中起來」，但一個做術語、一個做教材、一個做行業動態**）。**② ⭐ 「公司業績＋監管更新＋再保險洞察」說明它覆蓋的是**行業跟蹤**而非僅學習**——**可與 [[triple-i]]、[[asia-insurance-review]]、[[reinsurance-news]] 並讀：那些是內容生產者，而本項目是內容**聚合者****。**③ ⚠️ 最重要的一條如實標注：README 自己寫明當前形態與所述技術棧不一致**——**原文逐字為「the current MVP is a static Python/JavaScript prototype that generates a deployable site. The stack above reflects the intended production directi…」**——**即該技術棧是「預期方向」而非現狀，現階段 MVP 只是一個生成靜態站點的原型****；**同時其截圖表格三處實測均為「Placeholder」**——**故本詞條明確不主張該平台已具備所述前端形態，也不主張其已有可用介面**。**這是本輪主題的反面教材：當一個項目把「可信來源」當賣點時，讀者更應先看清它自己現在到底跑起來了多少**。**④ ⭐ 「AI-assisted development」被列入技術棧**（**本次未核實其 AI 輔助的具體程度**）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實的是**倉庫元數據與 README 全文（3,310 位元組）**，**未克隆、未運行、未打開其線上站點**，故**不能轉述其實際功能、數據來源清單、覆蓋面或更新頻率**；**② ⭐ 技術棧為 README 自述且被其自身標注為「預期方向」**；**③ 截圖實測為佔位符，故不主張已有可展示介面**；**④ ★3 說明關注度很低，不主張其成熟度或採用情況**；**⑤ 「AI 驅動」為項目自述，其具體實現與效果未核實**；**⑥ 是否有中文材料未核實**；**⑦** 本詞條**不主張**該項目提供精算計算、定價模型或可下載數據集**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/wjr0704/actuaryradar` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未運行、未核實部署、未打開線上站點**。
e.verified_note: GitHub API 实测（readme 与 repo 端点，2026-09-11）：MIT 许可｜★3｜fork 0｜JavaScript｜2,103 KB｜created 2026-07-06｜pushed 2026-09-10；README 实测 3,310 字节，副标题逐字「An AI-powered all-in-one Insurance Intelligence & Actuarial Learning Platform.」；功能七项逐字实测 Curated Insurance Intelligence / Personalized Learning Journey / Actuarial Knowledge Library / Company Results / Regulatory Updates / Trusted Public Sources / AI-assisted Learning；技术栈自述 Next.js/React/TypeScript/Tailwind CSS/Netlify/AI-assisted development；⚠️ README 自述「the current MVP is a static Python/JavaScript prototype…The stack above reflects the intended production directi…」（实测处截断）——技术栈为预期方向而非现状；⚠️ 截图表格三处实测均为 Placeholder，README 另称 Screenshots will be added soon，故不主张已有可用界面；未克隆/未运行/未打开线上站点；★3 故不主张成熟度或采用面；「AI 驱动」为项目自述未核实其实现
